tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Pozdrav, vodja klana. Sem sensei Hoshi. Naš klan je v gorah našel skrito dolino. Zgradimo vas, ki je noben tekmec ne bo našel.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Tvoja kovnica kuje kovance. Ko nad njo zaplava kovanec, ga tapni, nato pa Poberi.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Klan živi od kovancev. Tapni Gradi in postavi kovnico.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Zdaj okrepi Klansko trdnjavo: tapni grad, nato Izboljšaj.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Izboljšave terjajo čas. Trdnjava bo nared čez {time}: vrni se takrat ali tapni Dokončaj zdaj in porabi malo žada.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Tekmeci klani nas bodo napadali. Ob trdnjavi zgradi Stolp kunajev (Gradi, nato zavihek Obramba): strelja na vsakega napadalca v dosegu.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Ob trdnjavi zgradi Vadbeni dojo, Dvorišče odredov in Stolp kunajev (Gradi: zavihek Vojska, nato zavihek Obramba).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Odpri ploščo Vojska in izuri nekaj Shinobijev: hitra rezila, ki napadejo najbližjo stavbo.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Tudi urjenje terja čas: tvoji bojevniki bodo nared čez {time}. Počakaj ali tapni Dokončaj urjenje in porabi malo žada.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Tvoj prvi vpad. Tapni Napad, oglej si cilj, nato Napad! Na bojišču ti pokažem eno stvar naenkrat: Shinobije pošlji noter skozi svetlečo točko, nato jih ovij v dim, ko pridejo do stolpa: na bojevnike v dimu je mogoče streljati le od blizu.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Dober boj. Izboljšaj Vadbeni dojo, da odkleneš sabotere: za nekaj sekund onesposobijo obrambo. Najprej onesposobi, nato udari, in bojevnike ovij v dim tam, kjer je ogenj najhujši. Pobiraj, izboljšuj, napadaj in se pridruži zavezništvu.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Ena nagrada na dan, enaka za vse, nikoli naključna in nikoli naprodaj. Če zamudiš dan, se nič ne izgubi: naslednji prevzem je naslednji dan na seznamu. 28. dan prinese nov videz trdnjave.

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Posebne ponudbe se igralcem, mlajšim od 18 let, ne prikazujejo samodejno. Vse na zavihku Žad ostane na voljo znotraj tvoje omejitve porabe.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Dobava se začne takoj: prvo plačilo lahko prevzameš zdaj in nato po eno vsak dan; z nakupom se strinjaš, da izgubiš pravico do odstopa, kot to za digitalne vsebine dovoljuje zakon.

store.error.cancelled.text: Nakup je preklican. Nič ni bilo zaračunano.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Nakupi trenutno niso na voljo. Poskusi pozneje.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Nakup ni uspel. Če je bil znesek zaračunan, bo dobava izvedena, takoj ko trgovina to potrdi.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Ta vas je že imela ščit.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Noben bojevnik se ni boril, zato šteje kot vaja.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Hkrati oblikuj vse stavbe vrste {building}. Doseg strelja dlje, a šibkeje, in najprej meri na bojevnike v zadnji vrsti; Eksplozija zadene skupine, a strelja počasneje; Straža okrepi Stolp nebesnega loka, Žarovnik grenkega dima in pasti. Napadalci obliko vidijo, ko izvidujejo.

temper.locked.text: Kaljenje se odpre pri Klanski trdnjavi {level}.

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Kaljeno: vse stavbe vrste {building} imajo novo obliko.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Straža po vsej bazi oslabi tudi napadalčevo zdravljenje, oživljanje, žilavost in zaščito s ščiti.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Pred napadom napovej izid: če ga dosežeš, odneseš domov več plena, če ne, ne odneseš ničesar.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Stava zgrešena: napoved je bila {stars}★, zato domov ni prišel noben plen.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Tvoj odred je odnesel {pct} plena. Odredi z več vlogami odnesejo več.

raid.rejected.account_deleted.text: Tvoj spletni račun je bil izbrisan.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.
raid.rejected.conflict.text: Nasprotnikova vas se je spremenila v istem trenutku.
